programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本集將介紹沙烏地阿拉伯一種獨特的編織工藝- 「阿爾薩度」貝都因人用阿爾薩度親手為家庭製作所需的物品, 她們一邊編織布料, 一邊互相分享家人的消息, 阿爾薩度不只是織布技術, 更是一種團結家庭的集體藝術

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 如果這樣生活粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 在雲南大理，黎諾懿繼續協助法籍私房菜大廚預備招待各國來的朋友，終教他明白法國菜要吃多個小時的理由！諾懿煲出水鴨湯讓大家品評，結論竟是各人演技太好？諾懿乘船登上大理唯一有人居住的小島，到一間由曾是網際網路公司強人營辦的民宿，幫忙招待客人，客人卻嫌棄他太吵！工作步伐不需急促，反而令諾懿感到納悶，幸好老闆帶他到市集閒逛，諾懿竟找到適合楊明食用的手信？試過了歸隱田園，諾懿還堅持嚮往田園生活嗎？

programme.title: 兄弟姊妹去旅行粵
programme.desc: 蕭正楠、曹永廉、胡定欣、姚子羚「被組團」去瑞士旅行。兩女豪坐頭等艙，為何阿廉「一支公」坐商務客位？先到中古世紀小城琉森，走上打卡熱點教堂橋Selfie，再到旁邊市集買燒烤食物，兩男不理素食的子羚不停買肉，還取笑她們買了可辟邪的蔬果。乘坐全球首部360度旋轉纜車登上鐵力士山峰，鬥快滑雪兜，阿廉還差點出意外！在特里步湖划艇及燒烤，悠閒地分享旅行經歷，阿蕭有趟旅行後出現長達半年「後遺症」，聽聽他的忠告！

programme.title: 週六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主汛文提出與拍檔們圍繞「倫理道德」主題聊天，並以快問快答揭開序幕。她概述倫理學的三大分支概念，並進一步介紹其中的後設倫理學，還以插隊、偽君子等做例子；凱婷感同身受分享友人「講一套做一套」的經歷。回到開場問題，原來可反映眾人的抉擇是根據結果論、義務論或德性倫理學的思考模式。汛文也引述多位哲學家的學說，並帶出「兇手敲門」的思想實驗。她又引領拍檔將視野延伸至東方智慧，從中比較儒家、墨家與道家的學說。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 福祿壽訓練學院粵
programme.desc: 李龍基對被模仿感榮幸，這集親身亮相學院現場，與扮演他的福祿壽三子同台演唱。分組對決首回合「復刻經典舞台」上演，由專業評審羅冠蘭與觀眾一同打分。阮兆祥派趙頌宜演繹莫文蔚的<呼吸有害，頌宜表現獲大讚，得分竟因某人而拉低？王祖藍安排鄭詠謙扮曾位元、湯卓堅扮林子祥重演《聲生不息》舞台合唱，最終由於「第三者」出現令人略嫌失望？關嘉敏、葉泓聲獲李思捷指派重現張國榮的「鴛鴦舞王」演出，表演後卻感自責？

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集的菜式是西洋菜豆腐羹，主持人教大家怎樣吃到幼嫩的西洋菜，而又不用浪費的方法，材料清洗乾淨後，先將部分耐煮的材料放進鍋子裡熬煮，待味道出來後再加入西洋菜及豆腐，煮沸後勾芡，就成為清爽又有飽腹感的菜式

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更瞭解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的禰」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 心愛檸檬與拍檔凱龍找上祭與喵姆，向她們求教星光魔法。檸檬極度怕羞，難以跟陌生人溝通，枉論登台表演。祭找來希娜幫忙，希娜提出讓她代替檸檬登台。看過希娜的表演後，檸檬上網留言表達感受。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練黃Sir又再前來「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，指導大家展開一連串富趣味的體能鍛練。首先是利用豆袋與毛巾訓練反應與速度，某些動作要兩人一組去做，更會加入互相競逐的遊戲元素，令運動更添樂趣。隨後的平衡力訓練則用上雪糕筒作輔助，除了充當定位工具之外，還會兩人一組手持雪糕筒互相觸碰，詳情如何？這次「動物好萌友」，同來觀察可愛唐狗Lotus的生活點滴。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 2026年王者榮耀KPL年度總決賽·決賽直播粵普
programme.desc: 「王者榮耀」KPL十週年，兩支北京電競隊在年度總決賽狹路相逢，爭逐榮耀加冕！北京JDG戰隊一路由勝者組強勢推進，明星選手無畏、清融是致勝關鍵。北京WB戰隊從敗者組逆襲而歸，打野暖陽、射手昭珏都是陣中核心。此外，表演嘉賓周深會以歌聲加持「榮耀」殿堂。TVB翡翠台、明珠台接力播映這場BO7大戰，主持張與辰、彭家賢、施焯日、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編黃瀅仴，聯同資深電競賽事評述員老星，跟觀眾迎接「王者」駕臨！

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 香港連續16年成為樓價最難負擔城巿，為了讓買家更易「上車」，10多年前本港出現面積細、總價低的奈米樓，最細實用面積只有128呎。但近年陸續有奈米樓蝕讓，部分跌價超過五成，自住業主「先上車、後換樓」的計劃暫時未能實現，他們長年蝸居的生活是怎樣？政府五年規劃提出逐步增加室內樓面面積，讓巿民住大點。在解決迫切房屋需求的同時，政府如何在增加居住空間上作出平衡？樓面面積增加，港人買樓難的「老問題」又可否解決呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 節目曾報道的「Freelance攝影師」騙徒食髓知味，以萬多元酬金承接美容院宣傳工作，草草以手機攝錄美容療程後去如黃鶴，受騙東主揭發其另一劣行……TVB與內地跨媒體娛樂平台打造大灣區音樂盛事；陳展鵬首度主持遊戲節目，獲《玫瑰戰爭》一眾手足撐場。灣仔一舊式大廈天台，出現堆滿五金工具、維修材料的簡陋棚屋，卻不見負責人，街坊竟擔心工作室影響大廈結構？壞車「整極唔好」，車主反被告上法庭，維修公司有何理據？

programme.title: 渣打優先理財呈獻：Grand住去首爾粵
programme.desc: 參觀百年歷史韓屋，海寧細味傳統韓茶文化，尋回久違的自在慢活。隨後，她會跟韓國小鮮肉甜蜜約會學製陶瓷花樽，更齊齊登船夜遊睇靚景兼談天。嘉洛與朱仔相約大吃烤鰻魚補身，體驗韓國男人的進補之道。二人接著兵分兩路，嘉洛造訪頂流韓星御用美容院大改造，變身韓系型男走在街頭，成功吸引「韓國妹豬」集郵；朱仔則換上量身訂製西裝，靜心品嚐美酒獨享優雅時刻。壓軸三人會合享用新派韓國料理，前菜的滋味已令大家失去言語能力！

programme.title: 香港旅遊發展局呈獻：香港連場好戲粵PG
programme.desc: 從劇情片中的逆境奮鬥故事，領會香港精神！現已拆卸的九龍城寨，曾有「三不管」的傳奇色彩，兩主持約同演員伍允龍走進電影展覽館，穿梭光影場景與舊日時空交織的「圍城」。砵甸乍街、中環街市等歷史角落，散發著獨特的電影韻味；深入石澳，也可細味《喜劇之王》的追夢與愛情故事。《逆流大叔》於城門河奮力劃槳，電影導演陳詠燊訴說創作靈感。《毒舌大狀》為討公義，在前粉嶺裁判法院唇槍舌劍，演員謝君豪憶述實景拍攝法庭戲感受。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港車手方俊宇將夥拍德國名將晏高，徵戰澳門大賽車GT世界盃，俊宇從拍檔身上學到甚麼？西班牙球星大衛施華首戰港超聯，助至尊沙田以1比1賽和標準流浪，他還會暢談來港踢波感受。黎志豪當選新一任欖總主席，他提到希望將本港欖球推動到社群，及發展至大灣區。五位健美港將會出戰亞錦賽，備戰情況如何？香港馬術盛典將於1月舉行，法國騎手率先來港交流。另搜羅三鐵世界盃戰報，以及壁球公開賽、粵港澳大灣區匹克球賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 飛虎3壯志英雄#21粵PG
programme.desc: Mike涉嫌一宗謀殺案而被通緝，Mike向Don堅稱被陷害；博文問敏莉有否見過Mike，她稱沒有；素筠向敏莉表示自己患有漸凍症，希望她不要告訴博文；嘉軒和家寶調查許森的背景，發現收養他的濟群會有問題，於是再深入調查。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 節目曾報道的「Freelance攝影師」騙徒食髓知味，以萬多元酬金承接美容院宣傳工作，草草以手機攝錄美容療程後去如黃鶴，受騙東主揭發其另一劣行……TVB與內地跨媒體娛樂平台打造大灣區音樂盛事；陳展鵬首度主持遊戲節目，獲《玫瑰戰爭》一眾手足撐場。灣仔一舊式大廈天台，出現堆滿五金工具、維修材料的簡陋棚屋，卻不見負責人，街坊竟擔心工作室影響大廈結構？壞車「整極唔好」，車主反被告上法庭，維修公司有何理據？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更瞭解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的禰」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 如果這樣生活粵
programme.desc: 在雲南大理，黎諾懿繼續協助法籍私房菜大廚預備招待各國來的朋友，終教他明白法國菜要吃多個小時的理由！諾懿煲出水鴨湯讓大家品評，結論竟是各人演技太好？諾懿乘船登上大理唯一有人居住的小島，到一間由曾是網際網路公司強人營辦的民宿，幫忙招待客人，客人卻嫌棄他太吵！工作步伐不需急促，反而令諾懿感到納悶，幸好老闆帶他到市集閒逛，諾懿竟找到適合楊明食用的手信？試過了歸隱田園，諾懿還堅持嚮往田園生活嗎？

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 「豬隻飼養技藝」和「雞隻飼養技藝」同被列入本港首份非物質文化遺產清單，鄭世豪穿上一身保護衣物走進農場，見識香港的農業本色。隔著一道門，聽到「出雛機」中傳出「嘰嘰」叫聲，使鄭世豪欣喜若狂。何以他知道「鑒苗」的意義後，突然變得正經八百？經營一個豬場，竟要同時擔任「執媽」、陪月，甚至醫生、牙醫等角色？為初生豬寶寶注射疫苗、絕育、剪牙等工作，對豬場老闆而言屬家常便飯。為何不為豬寶寶剪牙，會令牠們無法成長？

programme.title: 2026英雄聯盟全球總決賽冠亞軍決賽直播粵普
programme.desc: 2026「英雄聯盟」全球大賽在美國舉行，韓國LCK戰區第一種子GenG、中國LPL戰區第二種子BLG，從瑞士輪、淘汰賽階段殺出重圍，會師總決賽戰場。GenG中路明星選手Chovy與BLG中路左手戰將Knight，迎來「左右手」巔峰對決，力爭帶領戰隊登上榮譽之巔。主持戴祖儀、林沚羿、彭家賢、電競評述員老星、彭泳熙、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編吳文懿，坐鎮TVB翡翠台，跟電競迷直擊這場BO5「中韓大戰」！

programme.title: 2026英雄聯盟全球總決賽冠亞軍決賽直播粵普
programme.desc: 2026「英雄聯盟」全球大賽在美國舉行，韓國LCK戰區第一種子GenG、中國LPL戰區第二種子BLG，從瑞士輪、淘汰賽階段殺出重圍，會師總決賽戰場。GenG中路明星選手Chovy與BLG中路左手戰將Knight，迎來「左右手」巔峰對決，力爭帶領戰隊登上榮譽之巔。主持戴祖儀、林沚羿、彭家賢、電競評述員老星、彭泳熙、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編吳文懿，坐鎮TVB翡翠台，跟電競迷直擊這場BO5「中韓大戰」！

programme.title: 食得好健康粵
programme.desc: 如有腹脹、便秘等問題，牛蒡是大家的腸胃救星！牛蒡含有豐富膳食纖維，有助促進腸道健康。市面上可找到出產自中國與日本的牛蒡，二者有甚麼分別？牛蒡口感粗糙，煒哥巧妙地將之切絲，烹調「涼拌牛蒡」和「牛蒡豬肉卷」，皆容易入口。「遊生私房菜」，廚藝專家梁雅琳亦以切絲做法，製成「牛蒡伴鮮果吞拿魚」，味道清新。盈盈善用茶水間的電飯煲，煮出「牛蒡蒟蒻飯」，有何竅門？來到減肥結算的日子，希望「食住瘦」的波波能否達標？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵PG
programme.desc: 「星夢」歌手同門較量，周柏豪夥拍連詩雅，對戰謝東閔與戴祖儀。日本拉麵文化博大精深，主打魚介湯底的拉麵店內多個虹吸式咖啡壺，有甚麼作用？雜貨店內每件商品僅得一件，卻非二手貨物，兩隊須猜出店舖貨源。泰式按摩花款多多，一款條狀物件有何另類用途？冰島一場所因擺放「神聖之物」，吸引不少充滿好奇心的旅客；兩隊競猜箇中「最大」與「最小」，Do姐見眾人一臉蠢相，大方給予貼士！哪一隊能獲幸運之神眷顧，贏得高額獎金？

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣不乏宏偉的表演藝術中心。台中的大型歌劇院出自日本建築師手筆，內部空間的玻璃幕牆引入自然光影與風景，亦運用視覺將戶外延伸至室內。劇院的曲形牆身建築講究，三個劇場的聲學設計絕不馬虎；樓頂設計與歌劇院中心連成一線，充滿日式美感，成打卡勝地。高雄衛武營由軍事基地轉成文藝建築，表演場館出自荷蘭建築師之手，外觀有如陸地上的一艘船。四個表演場館各有不同氛圍和聲樂效果，欣賞建築師在場館外觀、廣場設計上的特色。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣近年興起私人美術館浪潮，先跟小牟走進南投一座隱藏於林間的私人美術館，欣賞美術館配合土地原有地形的建築特色，邊走過長廊，邊感受植物給人沉澱心靈的感覺。淡水一座小巧精緻的私人美術館，外觀由四條柱支撐方形的玻璃建築，自然景觀倒影在玻璃牆上。藝術與建築匯合，令室內空間細節與藝術畫作配合得宜，更能感受藝術。綠意盎然的山上有一座純白的美術館，充滿著自由氣息，遊走於沒有限制、能隨心所欲的空間，閒適舒暢。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 閃亮宿突然下大雪，星夢頻道樂園也因此關門。為協助虹之咲突破設計的瓶頸，她找上未來求助，還帶未來到虛擬星夢頻道樂園遊玩。四眼哥哥見狀，便乾脆將虛擬樂園對外開放一天，吸引大家到場暢遊一番。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄遇上正在送貨的胖虎。胖虎見到大雄，便把全部貨品塞了給大雄，要大雄替他送貨。大雄聽到父母說要替他找補習老師，情急之下承諾會努力改善成績。但是大雄三分鐘熱度，更想出了一個鬼主意。

programme.title: 古典樂之星粵日
programme.desc: 貝多芬仍拿不定主意，是否加入莫札特一行，參加比賽。在機緣巧合下，貝多芬來到李斯特老家，在那裡，他看見李斯特作為傳統藝能世家之子的一面。縱使李斯特有意繼承家業，但複雜的身世卻令他難以登上舞台。

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊粵
programme.desc: 重慶的武隆仙女山有個容易登峰的觀景塔，看完美景更可沿滑梯滑下。再於一望無際的草原野餐，仙女山名從何來？盲盒再現，還一次過抽出三個目的地？首站張家界，走入國家森林公園，乘搭全球最長的戶外電梯，約一分鐘即上山！踏上全國首座高空玻璃橋，欣賞大峽谷的獨有地貌，再以高空滑索穿梭其中，有主持嫌慢，拍檔卻不斷大叫？除了自然美景外，原來張家界還有「夜蒲點」可看錶演，主持更被臨時拉上台跳舞，只因某人作怪……

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 西貢區海鮮食肆林立，大廚鍾貴華憑高超廚藝、低調作風殺出重圍，更助菜館「摘星」！芷珊約同星級食客陳煒、林澄光聚餐，椒鹽鮑魚外脆內嫩、金湯魚蓉羹鮮香無比，隱藏匠人心思與功夫。陳方藤將沾麵專門店引入香港，並堅持還原正宗和風滋味。湯底、麵條都是靈魂，主持從舌尖感受「拉麵陳」對日式拉麵的熱情。為炮製招牌酒香烤雞，餐廳主理人郭智恆對食材一絲不苟，竟要求以特定飼料養雞？他還善用侍酒師經驗，美酒搭佳餚，層次昇華！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 中環老字號清湯腩店，主理人潘國興多年來堅持以心製腩，至今仍不斷改良配方。這名老闆自言懶理網上火熱負評，但當芷珊問到可會認同自己性格有點「串」，他會如何回應？軟殼龍蝦是港產優質食材，出品獲國際性環保組織認證。負責人為龍蝦營造快樂養殖環境，飼料亦講究營養多樣化。據說可能是全港最美味的薯條？女主理人不惜花近十天時間備料製作。她本從事金融業，後因患病而決心追夢。談及在法國菜師父身上獲益良多，她更一度哽咽。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐家裡有一道常做的菜式「檸檬雞翼」，深受她的孩子和朋友歡迎；原來是她當年從資深前輩馮峰家裡偷師，再用自己的簡易方法來炮製。由於配料很多，Gigi姐想出了容易記住的分量比例，方便各位朋友跟著做。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 常言道美滿生活容易令人心廣「體胖」，今集嘉賓林夏薇今年投入幸福「少奶」生活之後，對於甜品的鍾愛依然絲毫不減，偏偏夏薇卻一直保持令人羨慕的完美體態，甚至揚言仍在尋求增肥方法！面對著「食極唔肥」的夏薇，阿古(古嘉俊)亦決定毫不保留，運用榛子、栗子、冧酒等豐富材料，炮製一款滋味十足的「冧酒榛子栗子車釐子撻」，盡情滿足她對美味甜品的渴求。

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 喵姆魔法失控，把自己、祭和檸檬送到魔法界，幸好被喵爺救起。喵姆受不了喵爺囉嗦，生氣跑走。檸檬發現喵爺的相簿，喵姆發現喵爺記得她愛吃馬卡龍，感到窩心，並決定用星光魔法向他傳達謝意。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 學習不只侷限於課室內，也可藉不同方法發掘更多成長機會。小朋友想展示才華，可考慮登上「My Little Show」舞台。11歲男生以一手好琴，演繹一首由法國作曲家依據窗外雨勢而寫的作品；透過音階與節拍的變化，就可奏出下大雨和微雨的分別？另有四位穿上型格舞衣的女生，帶來節奏感強勁的爵士舞舞蹈。結他導師則以<今日、<高山低谷呼籲大家要擁抱情緒，當遇上負面情緒時，也應找方法釋放出來，讓自己心情變好。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子為了晚餐吃到漢堡排，想在課堂上被老師揀中答問題，卻因太遲舉手而失敗，更因肚皮打鼓而出醜。友藏決心凡事靠自己，當他開始變得獨立，嫲嫲卻因為生活中缺少與友藏交流而感到寂寞。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每週港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 不少香港人移民外地生活，但隨著移民人士年紀漸長，因為生活便利、成本、家人團聚等原因，決定葉落歸根迴流。不過，他們並非回港生活，而是舉家北上養老，到底他們有何故事呢？又有甚麼問題要適應？本集記錄他們在迴流內地的心路歷程。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: BCT 強積金呈獻：弊傢夥！有嘢唔見咗﹗粵
programme.desc: 台慶劇《玫瑰戰爭》爆內訌！陳豪率姚子羚、陳楨怡、林景程，與對家的傅嘉莉、黃庭鋒、陳星妤、吳沚默一對一比拼，回答圖片中消失之物。首回合，嘉莉藉劇內是主持陳展鵬的太太而獲不少貼士，對手景程可會失利？接著《大時代》、《蓋世豪俠》等經典劇海報登場，子羚、庭鋒要說出被抹走的演員。楨怡、星妤對壘地標題時，有人第一題已需用錦囊？搶答回合，陳豪、沚默就香港情懷決勝負！究竟哪隊能晉級終極挑戰，力爭首集逾三萬元獎金？

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵
programme.desc: 水族館露營過夜，浪漫、淚水情感交織！遊戲贏家領獎勵，星妤趁海洋晚餐向關經翰逼供，反被問與某君關係；吳俊峰跟若思共度最後的觀星車時光。帳篷共枕浮現舊記憶，俞鋆瑞直言體會到珮文昔日感受。吳兆麟以小提琴、手作進擊，若思卻想讓男方放低人設？方智弘與沛珈打鬧相處，女神爆喊一幕竟是心動位？侯建民為可程改變，卻被電話亭環節重擊，女神內心動盪……嘉敏與吳旭東認真思考「距離」問題，還藉摩天輪、攤位遊戲累積夢幻時刻！

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻：一週星星粵
programme.desc: 主持區永權請來「TVB寶藏級」演員胡楓(修哥)、羅蘭受訪，先好奇二人的緋聞真偽，原來好友間亦曾八卦是真是假，修哥的回應更是一絕！重溫羅蘭姐於《神鵰俠侶》內的裘千尺恐怖造型，原來其母曾對此有微言？有指修哥在《誓不低頭》的口吃是本色演出，他如何做到現實口吃，對著鏡頭就說話順暢？到了退休年紀，能前往旅行也是樂趣和福氣。修哥最想全家親朋同行之地，竟然是……？如沒有投身演藝事業，兩人覺得自己會做甚麼工作？

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高質音樂平台，一眾歌手有展示音樂實力的機會之餘，也可讓樂迷更深入瞭解歌手的音樂故事。節目邀請「人氣」歌手擔任嘉賓，由嘉賓親自挑選其喜歡的新舊作品，並即場演唱，分享喜愛曲目。而一些樂壇新面孔亦會亮相，透過互動交流，展現音樂潛力。此外，每集緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新形勢，還會帶來不同歌手、創作人或製作人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至音樂業界的人和事。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 星廚莫燦霖帶波波到陳佑良師傅主理的餐廳，品嚐胡椒豬肚鳳吞燕、濃雞汁玻璃大蝦球等懷舊手工粵菜，令人回味無窮。居港泰國人Aimee推介泰國家常菜，以蟹肉及肉碎熬煮椰汁咖哩，配搭青瓜、炸鱸魚等同吃，別具風味。大廚陳國強帶暉哥到以豬雜馳名的潮州麵店，品嚐胡椒湯豬雜銀針粉、豬油撈麵等招牌美食，滋味十足。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到中環蘇豪區細嚐美式義大利菜，香草白酒煮美國馬尼拉蜆及焗義大利短通心粉，同樣不容錯過。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
飛虎3壯志英雄#22粵PG
programme.desc: 許森假意送李惠蘭和蔡肇培離開，途中惠蘭被殺手殺害，肇培大受打擊。在許森勸說下，蔡肇培終於答應製作DH2。杜文彬將股份轉給妹妹，使她成為裕天董事會主席。杜以盈請高子樂購買竊聽器來監聽杜文彬的一舉一動。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐家裡有一道常做的菜式「檸檬雞翼」，深受她的孩子和朋友歡迎；原來是她當年從資深前輩馮峰家裡偷師，再用自己的簡易方法來炮製。由於配料很多，Gigi姐想出了容易記住的分量比例，方便各位朋友跟著做。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 常言道美滿生活容易令人心廣「體胖」，今集嘉賓林夏薇今年投入幸福「少奶」生活之後，對於甜品的鍾愛依然絲毫不減，偏偏夏薇卻一直保持令人羨慕的完美體態，甚至揚言仍在尋求增肥方法！面對著「食極唔肥」的夏薇，阿古(古嘉俊)亦決定毫不保留，運用榛子、栗子、冧酒等豐富材料，炮製一款滋味十足的「冧酒榛子栗子車釐子撻」，盡情滿足她對美味甜品的渴求。

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊粵
programme.desc: 重慶的武隆仙女山有個容易登峰的觀景塔，看完美景更可沿滑梯滑下。再於一望無際的草原野餐，仙女山名從何來？盲盒再現，還一次過抽出三個目的地？首站張家界，走入國家森林公園，乘搭全球最長的戶外電梯，約一分鐘即上山！踏上全國首座高空玻璃橋，欣賞大峽谷的獨有地貌，再以高空滑索穿梭其中，有主持嫌慢，拍檔卻不斷大叫？除了自然美景外，原來張家界還有「夜蒲點」可看錶演，主持更被臨時拉上台跳舞，只因某人作怪……

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 西貢區海鮮食肆林立，大廚鍾貴華憑高超廚藝、低調作風殺出重圍，更助菜館「摘星」！芷珊約同星級食客陳煒、林澄光聚餐，椒鹽鮑魚外脆內嫩、金湯魚蓉羹鮮香無比，隱藏匠人心思與功夫。陳方藤將沾麵專門店引入香港，並堅持還原正宗和風滋味。湯底、麵條都是靈魂，主持從舌尖感受「拉麵陳」對日式拉麵的熱情。為炮製招牌酒香烤雞，餐廳主理人郭智恆對食材一絲不苟，竟要求以特定飼料養雞？他還善用侍酒師經驗，美酒搭佳餚，層次昇華！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 中環老字號清湯腩店，主理人潘國興多年來堅持以心製腩，至今仍不斷改良配方。這名老闆自言懶理網上火熱負評，但當芷珊問到可會認同自己性格有點「串」，他會如何回應？軟殼龍蝦是港產優質食材，出品獲國際性環保組織認證。負責人為龍蝦營造快樂養殖環境，飼料亦講究營養多樣化。據說可能是全港最美味的薯條？女主理人不惜花近十天時間備料製作。她本從事金融業，後因患病而決心追夢。談及在法國菜師父身上獲益良多，她更一度哽咽。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣不乏宏偉的表演藝術中心。台中的大型歌劇院出自日本建築師手筆，內部空間的玻璃幕牆引入自然光影與風景，亦運用視覺將戶外延伸至室內。劇院的曲形牆身建築講究，三個劇場的聲學設計絕不馬虎；樓頂設計與歌劇院中心連成一線，充滿日式美感，成打卡勝地。高雄衛武營由軍事基地轉成文藝建築，表演場館出自荷蘭建築師之手，外觀有如陸地上的一艘船。四個表演場館各有不同氛圍和聲樂效果，欣賞建築師在場館外觀、廣場設計上的特色。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣近年興起私人美術館浪潮，先跟小牟走進南投一座隱藏於林間的私人美術館，欣賞美術館配合土地原有地形的建築特色，邊走過長廊，邊感受植物給人沉澱心靈的感覺。淡水一座小巧精緻的私人美術館，外觀由四條柱支撐方形的玻璃建築，自然景觀倒影在玻璃牆上。藝術與建築匯合，令室內空間細節與藝術畫作配合得宜，更能感受藝術。綠意盎然的山上有一座純白的美術館，充滿著自由氣息，遊走於沒有限制、能隨心所欲的空間，閒適舒暢。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 航向未來粵
高朋滿座#227粵
programme.desc: 大年初三，眾人為避免三到高家打麻將「出術」的慣例，特意躲起來，但三使出「暗渡陳倉」之計，跟義及花到高家。三跟眾人打牌時，用盡方法，甚至迫有義「鬆章」，令她得以大贏。眾人叫苦連天，唯有急召喜回家對付三。

programme.title: 玉樓春#41粵普
programme.desc: 少春揭穿來者非李太醫真正妻兒，求得三日時間調查，卻被賈逢源反擒，映雪暗中相救後自盡而亡。孫貴妃重獲清白，但心灰意冷的她決意以後吃齋唸佛。梁京冠指當年孫遜害死少春父親，少春不信，但要用自己方法查明真相。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門有段古粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 學生用膳怕高消費，不如自行煮個「呃like學生餐」，帶返學校炫耀一番！把海中蝦截入獅子狗內一同炸，味道如何？炒飯加茄汁，或者未夠吸引，將炒飯放入蛋皮及紫菜卷內，吸引力暴升！棉花糖、牛油及脆脆米，可怎樣融合成可愛甜品？學生追求均衡營養，肥媽有甚麼方法令他們樂意享用飯後果？常被標籤為淡而無味的豆腐，與芝士及麵包糠混和，炸成「豆腐芝士球」，竟能令人感覺像吃薯仔球，輕易解決學童挑食問題！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 眼睛結膜負責分泌淚水黏液，保護眼睛。隨著老化，可能會患上結膜鬆弛症，出現眼睛有異物感、多眼水等不適狀況，眼科醫生細說診治資訊。張與辰將於聖誕舉行音樂會，更邀得外國才藝比賽冠軍唱將合作，二人如何越洋籌備演出？與辰自小受母親薰陶，三歲已愛上唱歌，還透露若非當初參加《中年好聲音3》，或已放棄音樂！他又暢談創作自家IP角色的靈感來源，更不忘以此行善，回饋社會。「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「黑白高纖蝦球」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵
programme.desc: 向「女神」示愛要顯誠意，在沙灘舉牌、點蠟燭加吹牧童笛；開太陽傘、用貝殼砌心心，原來上述好些舉動屬犯法？嘉賓馮盈盈答題前，笑言祖儀演女神不合常理！不少人喜歡帶寵物周圍去，但有些動物不能帶進郊野公園。盈盈以寵物可愛度作準則，想法夠獨特！手信不可亂買，花旗參、水煙壺、半熟蛋中，攜帶哪些入境香港會違法？每逢假日，許多市民都到公園紮營享受悠閒樂，竟隨時觸犯法例？有做功課的嘉慧獲森美點名稱讚，即緊張到口窒……

programme.title: 大帥哥#3粵PG

programme.desc: 嘉驄因與「開心小棧」新租客谷總爭用爐具煮食時受傷，嘉冰遂代為打理小棧。嘉驄提醒嘉冰提防谷總，指對方惹出不少麻煩，卻因預繳三個月租金而無法趕他走。另一方面，圓圓亦遭谷總滋擾，並從碧池口中得知對方原來是專騙富家女的老千。嘉冰實施「扣分制」整治谷總，只要扣滿分便要他搬走；谷總得悉嘉冰擁有物業，反過來對她展開追求攻勢……與此同時，朱基欲入住小棧卻苦無空房，得悉谷總是關鍵人物後，決定親自出馬「解決問題」……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#6粵PG 及 才駿HASHTAG M&G英卓及中銀香港 投資新靈感粵
programme.desc: 素希向無雙質疑破壞菲雅婚姻的計劃沒有意義，無雙表明必須繼續。《玫瑰》釋出會上，綺雲被揭出身世秘密，弟弟黎天明助她暫避風頭……寶兒坦白想加入天誠，被無雙否決。無雙指使心腹丁丁偷拍安安接客，並將影片匿名傳給雲生與鳳儀，雲生決定與安安解約。無雙表面協助安安，藉機質問當年子盈被下藥內幕，安安道出是受某人指使。鳳儀的「半億豪宅」被起底，網上瘋傳她與雲生關係不尋常。無雙探問綺雲的想法，綺雲自信雲生心中只有她。

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團粵
programme.desc: 網上頻道以「瘋狂首爾24小時快閃」為題出片，杜如風認為時間有限，片主定必精挑細選，決定「跟風」！排一小時隊吃貝果，如風提議芝士控不要揀芝士蜜糖味？店內MVP食品竟非貝果？聽到GD，如風立即心花怒放，往找跟偶像選用的同款沐浴露，也試將酒店的「香味」帶走。如風嚐味「人生必食燒肉」大讚無「伏」，連片主吃不到的燒豬皮，她亦有緣一試！行程以無需看價錢的飾品旗艦店作結，購物狂如風買買買，最終花費只是一千港元？

programme.desc: 寶兒從富商身上取走銀票後，與顧井逃走，至渡頭時，寶兒棄下顧井離去。玉麟為幫承康，替忠正接下甄選「天下無雙酒」之配給人選工作。忠正從杭州回來，見玉麟與承康態度親暱，感到不是味兒，遂對承康諸多為難。忠正要與承康測試酒膽，突然發生大火，忠正依計行事從二樓跳下，安然無恙，承康突然轉身不見，正當眾人以為他貪生怕死時，卻見他抱著顧井離開火場，原來放火乃忠正出之鬼主意，但顧井卻弄假成真，眾人均不恥忠正之所為。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋(完)
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【樸敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海(完)
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸開啟封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支援她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支援她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支援她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀唸的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支援。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝樸星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市佔率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會樸仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上台面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯絡。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手樸敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×樸炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

OMRON 血壓測量儀，一次測量即可獲得血壓和心律分析。通過Omron的智慧演算法，分析脈搏律動，幫助使用者及早發現潛在心房顫動風險。心房顫動風險是脈搏間隔不規律的現象，提早發現有助於降低中風的風險。居家也能輕鬆監測心臟健康。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Nature's Farm® Mirtogenol Plus+
programme.desc: Nature’s Farm Mirtogenol Plus+ is a clinically tested eye health formula developed by ophthalmologists and scientists from the UK and Italy. It helps reduce eye fatigue, dryness, and blurred vision for clearer, more comfortable vision. Nature’s Farm Mirtogenol Plus+ 為眼科醫生及英意科研團隊研發的臨床護眼配方，結合兩大強效抗氧化成分 Pycnogenol® 法國松樹皮與 Mirtoselect® 歐洲藍莓，並新增柑橘類黃酮，有助改善眼部微迴圈、支援健康眼壓、對抗用眼壓力與氧化損傷，緩解眼睛乾澀、疲勞與模糊感，讓視力更清晰、更舒適。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - La Gourmet Flame Electric Cooker

programme.desc: Benjamin dreams of being a great doctor, but his internship at his father’s ward doesn’t turn out the way he hoped. His experience as a junior doctor, with its overwhelming responsibility and stiff competition, forces him to confront his limits and fears.

programme.title: The Black Minutes
programme.desc: Vicente Rangel, a musician turned detective, embarks on a police case to catch a murderer of girls in a corrupt oil town on the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Hunters On A White Field
programme.desc: Deep in the Swedish woods, three friends go on an extended weekend hunting trip. After an initial spell of success, the animals suddenly vanish without a trace. Despite being in a forest without animals, the men decide that the hunt must continue.

programme.title: I'm Not In Love
programme.desc: After receiving a marriage ultimatum from a woman he's not sure he truly loves, Rob is up against the clock to realise he should stop looking for the fabled 'Miss Right' and learn to see what's right in front of him.

programme.title: Milk Teeth
programme.desc: Living in a small rural community, Skalde navigates societal stigma due to having an “outsider” mother. When she befriends a mysterious girl in the woods, Skalde jeopardizes everything, struggling to balance loyalty to her community and her newfound bond.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Hide-and-Seek, the Giant Pacific Octopus
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Circus
programme.desc: It's Teletubby Circus time! Tinky Winky balances on the tight rope, Dipsy juggles, Laa­Laa flies on the trapeze and Po is a funny clown.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Pizza
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'pizza' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of pizza - a round pizza, a tomato pizza, a party pizza and a cheesy pizza! There's a banana pizza and Dee plays a game of ping pong with a pizza!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Tastebuddies
programme.desc: Messy discovers that things just don't taste the same when he has a cold, especially his favourite chewy green socks.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - It Came From Planet Boogie
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can't stop dancing?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - The Salmon Run, Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska's a cool place to watch the salmon run, but Glitch opens a 'fishy taxi service' to help the salmon avoid tricky waterfalls and greedy bears. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Sleepover
programme.desc: A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late! But when Muffin shows up exhausted after missing her nap, the girls get more fun than they bargained for.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Featherwand
programme.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Lost Pachycephalosaurus
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Pillow
programme.desc: Bella and Lift wake up from a lovely nap and visit Hettie in the Ice Disco. Hettie and the Playtimers do a superstretch dance to help wake everybody up!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Obstacle Course Badge
programme.desc: It's time for the annual Animal Obstacle Course Race- the animals need to work together in teams to complete the course. Duggee has his Obstacle Course badge, together with the squirrels they form a team and the fun begins.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Going Slow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to enjoy things at a slower pace. However, they come across Tortoise who needs to get to the hospital as his wife is having babies. Duggee and the Squirrels need to get him there fast!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Memory Badge
programme.desc: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it! He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The squirrels start to look for it but they can't find the tooth anywhere. Time to think carefully and remember!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Wolong Panda Reserve, China
programme.desc: Lars and Foz are in the Wolong Nature Reserve in China, taking care of the 2,000 pandas that live in the wild there. Grim HQ has also landed in the Wolong reserve, having been through a monsoon. The rain has washed Grandmaster Glitch's ship sparkling clean. Glitch is grumpy - he likes his Grim HQ to be dirty and, well, grim! He tries to use his mud splatterer to make Grim HQ dirty again, but he can't get high enough to reach the top of the ship. He needs to build some scaffolding, so he sends hi

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Compass Navigators
programme.desc: Kyan and Foz are working on their compass navigation skills and need to find the North Tower within a magnificent maze in order to pass their academy test. Grandmaster Glitch also tries to join in the amazing maze action but ends up getting lost. In a fit of frustration, he glitches the maze by bulldozing through the hedges with his Grim-mower. The Grim-mower dives into the ground, causing the pathways to crack. Foz falls into one of the cracks and needs to be rescued.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S24 - Emily to the Rescue

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Chicken
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'chicken' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of chickens - a brown chicken, a white chicken, a clucking chicken and some friendly chickens.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Messy's Lost Balloon
programme.desc: Messy loves balloons, whatever colour they are, but what is inside them to make them float up high into the sky?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Breakdown Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan the ferry can't shut his engine off, so he's speeding out of control around the lake. How will Mojo and Bo get aboard to take control and steer Bryan to safety?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Tomatina Festival, Buñol, Spain
programme.desc: When the Go Jetters find the Grimbots shipping overripe tomatoes into the Spanish town of Bunol, they put a stop to whatever Glitch is up to - until they find out that the tomatoes were destined for the famous Tomatina Festival, the biggest food fight in the world. Can the Go Jetters fix their own 'glitch' and save the festival?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Early Baby
programme.desc: Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they both find that their games actually have a lot in common.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Quetzalcoatlus Egg
programme.desc: When a Quetzalcoatlus egg Jen has been watching is knocked out of its nest, Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to retrieve and reunite it with its family.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Paper Plate
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with paper plates, just like Sketch in Boxtropolis, who makes paper plate mega monster masks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Spooky Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound. They can see that something has spooked the chickens, so they stop what they are doing to investigate. They come across several different items, such as ghostly white footprints, and then they spot a floating sheet. What is going on? The Squirrels will have to take the long way round if they want to catch whatever it is.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Obstacle Course Badge
programme.desc: It's time for the annual Animal Obstacle Course Race- the animals need to work together in teams to complete the course. Duggee has his Obstacle Course badge, together with the squirrels they form a team and the fun begins.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Going Slow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to enjoy things at a slower pace. However, they come across Tortoise who needs to get to the hospital as his wife is having babies. Duggee and the Squirrels need to get him there fast!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Map Readers
programme.desc: Glitch races the Go Jetters across the Academy to find the lost G.O. Dome of the Ancients.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Wolong Panda Reserve, China
programme.desc: Lars and Foz are in the Wolong Nature Reserve in China, taking care of the 2,000 pandas that live in the wild there. Grim HQ has also landed in the Wolong reserve, having been through a monsoon. The rain has washed Grandmaster Glitch's ship sparkling clean. Glitch is grumpy - he likes his Grim HQ to be dirty and, well, grim! He tries to use his mud splatterer to make Grim HQ dirty again, but he can't get high enough to reach the top of the ship. He needs to build some scaffolding, so he sends hi

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Shankar's Makeover
programme.desc: There's a fancy dress competition on the railways and while Thomas and the others are excited, Shankar doesn't want to join in.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Anniversary
programme.desc: When Nikhil and Jay try to help Appa and Amma surprise each other for the anniversary of their first date, things quickly get out of hand!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Wonder Vole
programme.desc: Benjamin can't find his favourite toy, Wonder Vole anywhere. Stanley suggests they retrace his steps but have no luck. Maybe Wonder Vole Pyjamas will help Benjamin feel brave.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treat
programme.desc: Stanley's friends throw him a birthday party. No work for Stan today. Cynthia and Jose take a call from Amare, her tractor is stuck in the mud. Soon, so are all Stanley's vehicles.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Don't Like Bananas
programme.desc: From broccoli soup to cheeseburgers and blue cheese, the funny animals chat about the best and worst things to eat.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to paint
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran head to the library, but the children's section is closed for redecoration!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want dad to play two different games, so dad tries to play both at the same time. While also watching the race on TV.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. Lovely...but Tag can't sleep! Don't worry, Duggee can help, he has his Sleeping Badge and can offer a few tricks to get to sleep.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Dentist
programme.desc: Charley can't wait to show Dentist Maisy his wobbly tooth!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Go to the Moon
programme.desc: Maisy wants to do one last thing before bedtime: visit the moon with her friends!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pear
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the fastest woodwind player - Pear!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Parsley
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Parsley sings a rock song.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Super Secret
programme.desc: Evil Pea traps Supertato to discover the secret of his superstrength.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Wishing Tree
programme.desc: Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli's help to save the day.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Stairs
programme.desc: A musical staircase magically appears in Teletubbyland. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po take turns making music as they go up and down the stairs.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. programme.title: 人生調色盤第302集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 妙法之歌
programme.desc: 佛光山為延續開山祖師星雲大師「音樂弘法」理念而推出的大型佛教法華經清唱劇。此作品打破傳統宗教音樂的框架，創新地將東方佛教經典文字與西方大型交響樂、合唱團融為一體，展現佛法慈悲救苦的精神與心靈解脫的歷程。

programme.title: 土壤的身世第8集
programme.desc: 土壤是本片主角，用第一人稱手法做為主軸串連，詮釋台灣土壤獨特的個性、脾氣、習慣和美貌，看她如何在夾縫中求生存、如何與保育工作者及科學家們親密對話，以期能達到捍衛物種生命、保護環境的潛移默化效果。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1876集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－鬱方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，瞭解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 人間佛學院第96集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: 歡樂家長群第5集
programme.desc: 編劇劉向上日常時間安排相對自由，在家裡負責兒子果寧、女兒果寶的教育陪護，妻子戴靜選擇在薪酬較高的外地公司打拼。劉向上一家因為孩子開學而與朋友、鄰居及其他學生家長成為群友，面對各種突發狀況的新手家長們和鬼馬精靈的孩子們共同迎接教育新課堂、人生新起點的故事。

programme.title: 布袋小和尚第5集
programme.desc: 說趣事․悟禪理․善能量以生動易懂的品德道理為主旨，精采呈現一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禪理動畫作品。《布袋小和尚》是中國大陸首部為孩子原創製作的禪意動畫片。《布袋小和尚》以彌勒佛化身的布袋和尚為原型，以奉化雪竇寺為故事發生地，講述一個逍遙自在、無拘無束、笑口常開的大肚彌勒小和尚，和他的夥伴小布袋、吉祥鳥，被委以修建廟宇的重任。在重建廟宇的過程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各種稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚運用他的聰明才智和神奇布袋，揚善懲惡，幫助百姓克服困難，用愛心溫暖人間。劇情輕鬆有趣又感人，將中華傳統美德融入其中，使得教育與娛樂相結合，教導少年兒童做好事、說好話、存好心等行為道德，在笑中體會道德的光芒

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第23集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉裡衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第6集
programme.desc: 黎蘭章出生於南部農家，從小跟著父親做農，結婚後家庭幸福美滿，孰料先生早逝，她獨力撫養兩個孩子，這段期間蘭章受到朋友同事的關心與照顧，才能度過人生的低潮，為了回饋社會的愛心，蘭章加入了慈濟。因受到上人的感召，蘭章自認文的不會，武的也不會，只會做環保。蘭章十幾年不感動許多志工紛紛加入，但困難的是始終沒有固定的環保點，她的堅持與不退，感動了麗梅師姊，提供固定的場地給蘭章做環保，也終於不用再流浪。她們用做環保來實踐上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，蘭章跟麗梅認為環保道場就是人間淨土，也是她們及志工們的心靈修道場。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第192集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 名人書房第96集
programme.desc: 閱讀就像是漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中！每位名人的讀書故事，皆是一段動人的奇幻旅程，透過《名人書房》紀錄影片帶領大眾看見閱讀改變生命的力量。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第285集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第40集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 衲履足跡第1468集
programme.desc: 以 證嚴上人出門行腳各地的隨緣開示為內容，近距離同霑一代宗師的法髓甘露與清淨智慧。以真實記錄譜寫現代阿含經，使全球大眾如同親隨。

programme.title: 映照人生第506集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛台製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第606集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑後，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 包青天第128集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨齡差距的結伴青春旅行，走訪在地文化行銷台灣，世代差異的旅遊個性激盪出充滿意外性的實境自助旅行。當稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，會擦出什麼火花呢?這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！從陌生到熟悉！ 從畏懼到麻吉！讓小鮮肉成長！讓老熟肉回春！不囉唆！現在出發吧～

programme.title: 小曉第1集
programme.desc: 總是活在自己世界的小曉，在學校常常被霸凌排擠，媽媽薇芳也將她視為麻煩，爸爸又長期在國外工作，只有班導保羅能夠理解她。然而，某個颱風天下課後，小曉意外目睹媽媽與班導間不可告人的秘密，她的世界也因此開始改變...

programme.title: 近視第1集
programme.desc: 7 歲的婷婷近視了，但是她不想要戴眼鏡，因為她發現媽媽只有在幫她滴眼藥水的時候，才會將注意力放在她身上。婷婷想要利用點眼藥水的機會與媽媽相處，卻反而將媽媽推得更遠，最後婷婷才發現原來她和媽媽都是獨立的個體。

programme.title: 名人書房第8季:第10集
programme.desc: 節目以「閱讀」為核心，邀請各界跨世代名人走進私人書房。透過深度實景紀錄與訪談，梳理受訪者的人生故事、閱讀習慣及其鍾愛的書籍，探索文字如何形塑思想並啟發心靈。

programme.title: 前輩，好樣的!第22集
programme.desc: 人到了退休時刻，面臨人生道路的交叉點，銀髮前輩們的明天，要走上哪一條路？其實，人到了退休年齡，是另一個「青春」的起始，也是「隨心所欲的青春」，這個時候的自己，智慧了、成熟了、時間多了、心更自由了，不受拘束的身心，正是青春的要件

programme.title: 我們的島第1382集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 下課花路米第1406集
programme.desc: 針對小學中、高學年生所設計的探索型兒童節目。為了喚起孩子們對台灣的鄉土關懷，節目以「生活台語」和「城鄉探索」為主軸，穿插逗趣幽默的故事情節，以輕鬆的方式帶領孩子瞭解台灣的歷史、人文、文化。

programme.title: 反正你也不睡覺第42集
programme.desc: 《反正你也不睡覺》是由作家吳曉樂、陳栢青與街訪主持人傑尼共同主持的讀書節目，每週兩天，線上上跟你說一個故事，可能是一本小說、一封陌生人的來信，或邀請大來賓到現場。

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第310集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 行走TIT第427集
programme.desc: 台灣不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公視推出原鄉部落行腳節目《行走TIT》，用腳、用眼、用心行走，帶觀眾認識新台灣！首季探索十三個部落，挖掘罕為人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 群山之島與不去會死的他們第2集
programme.desc: 《群山之島與不去會死的他們》是來自台灣高山嚮導的四個故事，全系列共4集。跟著他們回到最初的啟蒙之山，一同探尋他們的登山哲學。本節目於2021年2月25日於公視主頻播出。

programme.title: 少年願望事務所第81集

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第173集

programme.title: 獨立特派員第978集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查采訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公影片道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.desc: 即時新聞，讓聽眾得知最易於親近的國內外大事。

programme.title: 奇蹟第1集
programme.desc: 航一因為父母離異，和弟弟龍之介分居兩地。他的學校裡流傳著一個傳聞─「九州新幹線通車那天，當列車高速交會的瞬間，心願就能成真！」。 航一相信這個傳說，他聯同弟弟龍之介，開始密謀一樁驚天動地的「奇蹟計畫」。住在鹿兒島的航一和媽媽，真的能夠和住在福岡的龍之介和爸爸，重新找回一家四口的快樂時光嗎？

programme.title: 神來的時候第1集
programme.desc: 失去音訊多年的「陳英雄」，在父親的告別式上重新回到哥哥「啟田」一家人的生活。他離經叛道、不按牌理出牌的風格讓哥哥嫂嫂頭痛不已，卻意外吸引了正值青春期的姪子「阿俊」，兩人也因此成為忘年之交。

programme.title: 行走TIT第362集
programme.desc: 台灣不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公視推出原鄉部落行腳節目《行走TIT》，用腳、用眼、用心行走，帶觀眾認識新台灣！首季探索十三個部落，挖掘罕為人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 大山小腳ㄚ第5集
programme.desc: 透過荒野挑戰的設計，讓孩子在壓力、未知與合作中「做中學」，不僅能學習山林知識與生存技能，更能培養自我認識、溝通與解決問題的能力，將荒野任務轉化為真實的成長經驗。

programme.title: 浩克慢遊第14集
programme.desc: 「浩克慢遊」，主題設定為「英雄的旅程」，製作人林彥輝分享，靈感來自旅行途中，遇見的那些堅守信念的人們，希望透過本季節目學習他們的勇敢，並感謝他們的付出，旅行是一種自我療癒的過程。

programme.title: 二呆流浪記之完全大人手冊第13集
programme.desc: 《二呆流浪記之完全大人手冊》，找來兩位新生代備受矚目演員曾敬驊、朱軒洋搭檔首度主持實境節目，希望藉由節目來探討兩人正值「25歲」這個由男孩轉大人的人生重要階段，如何面對「成為大人」這門課。。

programme.title: 公視晚間新聞第319集
programme.desc: 《公視晚間新聞》因為新聞內容淨化、幾乎看不到其他台灣新聞台的血腥、火爆的場面，且素材多元，針對民生消費、台灣政經社會、人文環境等議題報導都極為深入

programme.title: 全球現場-漫遊天下第43集
programme.desc: 這個節目以簡單易懂的方式解釋複雜的國際新聞，並透過文字和圖表的輔助說明，幫助觀眾更好地理解。我們專注於國際現況和重大議題，提供評論和分析，讓觀眾能清楚地瞭解全球情勢。

programme.title: 一字千金第6集
programme.desc: 《一字千金》是台灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制、全能製作公司製作、天衍互動技術協助、以漢字為主題並體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱“電視史上結合App、最緊張、最刺激的文字書寫比賽”，並曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎。由曾國城擔任主持人。節目中所有書寫字型均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，並以常用國字標準字型表、次常用國字標準字型表收錄的常用漢字為範疇。至於答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據。

programme.title: 也好吃第3集

programme.title: 隨便吶!我們趕快開始第1集
programme.desc: 故事描寫一位卡在大學畢業與30大關中間點的台北女孩「水梨」。她一邊在社群紛擾中摸索插畫家的志向，一邊被自己愛耍小聰明、逃避現實的習慣拖累...

programme.title: 西瓜樂園第1集
programme.desc: 描繪受家庭暴力陰影籠罩的日常。母親在白晝扛下家計擺攤賣西瓜，夜晚則帶著孩子四處逃離施暴的父親。

programme.title: 下一站，托斯卡尼第1集
programme.desc: 講述一名藝廊主理人在不得已情況下，找上久無聯絡的畫家父親，要一同去義大利將房子賣掉籌措資金。荒廢20多年的老屋，要找到買主得大力整修一番，這對感情疏離的父子被迫擱下原本生活，在這裡開啟一段人生中難得的朝夕相處日子。

programme.title: 女神第1集
programme.desc: 手上拿著撿到的身分證，在回收廠工作的逃逸移工綠茶，對照片上面的女人一見傾心，決定她就是他的女神。鄉親阿軟為了替即將被遣返的好兄弟一了心願，誤打誤撞帶上台灣司機，踏上尋找女神的旅程。
